title: Daily Planning & Focus Polish (v4.3.0)
summary: Daily planning now feels easier to run, focus controls are clearer, and support flows give you faster help with less typing.
highlights: Daily planning and Focus Intention flows are now cleaner and easier to manage
Session setup, Shield, and focus controls feel more consistent across the app
Header and progression visuals are clearer, with smoother XP feedback and polish
improvements: Support form now better auto-fills your info (including linked email and saved name)
Support requests now send clearer contact context so replies are easier
Large internal cleanup improved stability and maintainability across core features
